oddities: Two parallel status vocabularies for one enum: default mode statusLabels (계획/수강중/완료/재수강) vs compact statusPillLabels (예정/수강중/이수/재수강); the 'failed' state is labeled 재수강 (retake) in both.

Two parallel status color systems: card surface statusColors uses brand navy for planned (bg-[#153974]/5 border-[#153974]/20) and gray for completed, while compact statusPillColors uses Tailwind blue-100/700 for planned and emerald-100/700 for completed; enrolled pill is green-100/700 — green vs emerald sit side by side and are nearly indistinguishable.

Color collisions across dimensions: general_required (교양필수) chip = bg-blue-100 text-blue-700 = planned (예정) status pill, so a planned 교양필수 course in compact mode shows two identical blue chips meaning different things; major_elective (전공선택) chip = 부전공 department chip = bg-orange-100 text-orange-700; major_required (전공핵심) chip = failed (재수강) pill = bg-red-100 text-red-700.
Adjacent category hues red-100 (전공핵심) and rose-100 (전공필수) are very close; violet-100 (교직) and purple-100 (복수전공) are also near-identical.

categoryColors map is duplicated verbatim in CourseCard.tsx and ReadOnlySemesterColumn.tsx; the short-label map (전핵/전필/…) is duplicated in SemesterColumn.tsx (inline IIFE) and ReadOnlySemesterColumn.tsx; the category enum union is re-typed inline in CourseCard and SemesterColumn props instead of imported — no shared token/constant.
Arbitrary micro type sizes text-[9px] (interactive compact status pill) and text-[10px] (chips, credits) fall below Tailwind's text-xs (12px); 9px clickable text is a legibility/target-size concern.

Hard-coded hex in these files is confined to the brand trio #153974 / #3069B3 / #00AACA (no off-brand hex), but every semantic color (category, status, destructive hover) is a raw Tailwind palette class with no token layer; brand is used only for planned tint, focus ring, Focus badge and show-more link.

Focused semester uses two different brand colors for one state: cyan ring (ring-2 ring-[#00AACA] border-[#00AACA]) on the Card plus navy header tint (bg-[#153974]/5) and navy Focus badge (bg-[#153974] text-white).

When a column is both isFocused and isOver, both class strings are concatenated; twMerge in Card keeps the later ring-[#00AACA]/50, so the solid focus ring dims to 50% while a course is dragged over it (likely unintended).

Tailwind v4 confirmed (@import "tailwindcss"; grep found no border-color compat rule in globals.css): Card base `border`, column header `border-b`, and the default status pill `rounded-full bg-white border` have no border color class, so they render in currentColor (text-gray-900 / inherited) rather than the v3-era gray-200 — much darker borders than the explicit border-gray-100/200 used elsewhere in the same components.

CourseCard repeats shadow-sm hover:shadow-md transition-shadow that Card already supplies (twMerge dedupes, harmless); Card's transition is shadow-only so ring/bg state changes on SemesterColumn (focus, isOver) snap with no transition.
Four border radii in one surface: rounded (chips), rounded-md (read-only rows), rounded-lg (Card, dashed empty box), rounded-full (status pill, Focus badge, icon buttons).

Inconsistent chip padding: default chips px-1.5, compact chips px-1, read-only compact chips px-1.5 — compact CourseCard and compact ReadOnly rows use different chip metrics at the same text-[10px] size.

Credit meta sizing differs between compact CourseCard (text-[10px] text-gray-500) and ReadOnly rows (text-xs text-gray-500) for the same '{n}학점' string; semester subtitle margin is mt-1 in SemesterColumn but mt-0.5 in ReadOnly.

Hover color on the SVG glyph itself (hover:text-red-500 / hover:text-amber-500) fires only when the pointer is over the 16px icon, not the padded button; the button's hover:bg fires on the whole 24px target — mismatched feedback areas. Remove button hover bg is white on an already light card (hover:bg-white) — nearly invisible on completed (gray-50) cards and literally invisible if a parent is white.

Clickable header <div onClick> in SemesterColumn (onFocus) and ReadOnlySemesterColumn (toggle) has cursor-pointer but no role=button, tabIndex or key handler — not keyboard reachable; ReadOnly nests a <button> inside that clickable div (double activation target).

Compact status pill button sits inside the dnd-kit draggable wrapper that spreads listeners on the whole card; handleStatusClick stops propagation of click but pointerdown still reaches the drag sensor — no activationConstraint is visible in these files, so tap vs drag conflicts are possible on nested buttons.

First-time 'pulse' hint is a module-level mutable boolean (statusHintShown) — shared across all cards, resets on reload, never persisted; it also only exists in compact mode while the tooltip title (클릭하여 상태 변경: 예정 ↔ 이수) is likewise compact-only, leaving the default-mode toggle unexplained.
Status toggle is a 2-step planned↔completed cycle; enrolled and failed can only be clicked into completed and the UI never offers 수강중/재수강 as targets, yet the aria-label says generic '상태 변경'.

Destructive confirmations use native window.confirm (unstyled, 합니다체) while the rest of the planner is custom-styled; 'Focus' badge is English in a Korean UI; thrown error text in useCourseStatus is English and never surfaced — status update failures roll back silently with no toast.
departmentLabel coloring branches on Korean string equality ('복수전공' / '부전공') rather than an enum key.
Compact clamp uses two independently hard-coded limits (MAX_VISIBLE = 4 and max-h-[280px]) that must be kept in sync with compact card height by hand.

No prerequisite warning, credit-overload warning, or threshold coloring exists in these planner files: credit totals are plain text-gray-500 regardless of value; any such warnings must live elsewhere (outside this reader's list).
No DragOverlay is rendered here; the drag ghost is the source element itself at opacity-50 translated via CSS.Translate — overlay styling (if any) is in the parent planner page, not in these files.

Gray scale is consistently gray-* in these four files (no slate/zinc/neutral mix); Card base sets text-gray-900 but every text node overrides to gray-800/500/400, so gray-900 is only visible via the currentColor borders noted above.
